surfaces.name: The first Gravitas
surfaces.replacementLacks: running the first version in a browser without a checkout: the code, the commit a5d08fc and every later commit stay in git, the v2.0.0 tag and the Zenodo deposit, but nothing there runs on a click
surfaces.why: A single file, the sandbox as it was put online in July 2025, with Save and Load inert and no accessibility run. It is a museum piece: one quiet link from the model page's footer, no shipped link, no Library entry. The archive keeps the code; what it cannot keep is the click-to-run.

ruling.quote: give the history original page a freeze
ruling.reason: The function counts six costs and keeps the page (R6b: one signal of six). It does not count that this is the one published page with no content-security policy, and that on opening it asked fonts.googleapis.com for a stylesheet with no opt-in (that import has since been removed, D-R10-51 option (a); the policy is still absent). A plain FREEZE notice was the gate author's recommended alternative to RETIRE; the archive keeps the code either way, and removing the page is a different decision from freezing it.
ruling.reverses: Carl saying so in a register row. The page stays frozen until the next checkpoint (171, then 287) judges it again; real referrer data, a named adopter or a Library entry that links it would be new evidence for that judgment. No threshold or rule was moved to produce this ruling, and a seventh cost signal is not added.

surfaces.consequence: A notice on the page in both languages (frozen, no new features, kept as a record, where to go instead), pinned by tests/historyOriginal.test.js; no change to what the page does, no date, no new dependency; the one font import (a third-party request) is removed. Owner ruling D-R10-51; the function still gives KEEP (R6b).

surfaces.name: Analysis lab (two sections)
surfaces.why: Not a page: "Analyze" on the experiment runner and "Compare the fits" in the Observatory fit panel, two lazy chunks over js/analysis. Reading a result closely (intervals, sources of uncertainty, model weights) is not done anywhere else. A section of Observe, not a destination.

surfaces.name: The "Contributed" catalog section
surfaces.replacementLacks: nothing: a contributed entry already carries a "Contributed" badge and a "Contributed by" row in the list; the section adds a heading and an empty-state message
surfaces.why: No catalog entry has origin "contributed" (0 of 10) and the section says so. The attribution lives on the entry; the section is presentation only.
surfaces.consequence: 166 removes the section's heading and its empty-state line. A contributed entry keeps its badge and its 'Contributed by' row in the list; the pointer to CONTRIBUTING_CONTENT.md moves to the catalog's intro. Presentation: no support period (policy scope).

surfaces.name: The Library's "Where it runs" facet
surfaces.replacementLacks: nothing a student asks for: the kind facet and the topics already choose by what a thing is, and the facet names subsystems ("3-D lab", "Observatory") instead of tasks
surfaces.why: Navigation model: a student-facing reason or none. None was found: no investigation, course or document tells a student to choose by it, and the roadmap lists it as naming where code runs. Prompt 163 (PR #409, open, ratified in D-R10-42) already removes it; this verdict agrees by the function.
surfaces.consequence: None for 166 if Prompt 163 (PR #409, open) merges; if it does not, 166 removes the facet. Presentation: no support period (policy scope). A Library link that names the old filter still opens the Library.

surfaces.name: Activity format: route
surfaces.why: The smallest format that is still the whole predict, run, measure, explain cycle. Three subjects use it (orbital speed, binary planets, star sizes).

surfaces.name: Activity format: guided
surfaces.replacementLacks: the exact step selection and its stable assignment id
surfaces.why: Six of the lesson's twenty-three steps, between the route (four) and the lab (ten). Only orbital speed has one; the route plus the lesson's own pace cover most of what it does.

surfaces.name: Activity format: lab
surfaces.replacementLacks: the exact step selection and its stable assignment id
surfaces.why: Ten of twenty-three steps with a controlled comparison and a transfer case. Only orbital speed has one. The whole lesson, assigned in full, covers it; the format is the cut.
